result:
I updated `src/exports/links.ts` so `DownloadLink` now has `expiresAt: string`. `createDownloadLink` sets it to 7 days after creation, as an ISO timestamp. The URL now looks like `...?token=<token>&expires=<URL-encoded expiresAt>`.

I haven't run or tested it. I also didn't check whether anything else builds `DownloadLink` objects or reads the URL, and nothing in this change rejects a link after it expires. That check would need to happen wherever the link is validated.
